in_marathi.name: Chandak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra' meaning 'Moon'. This name is dedicated to Lord Chandrama, the Moon God in Hindu mythology, representing calmness, wisdom, and protection.

in_bengali.name: Chandak

in_bengali.long_meaning: Chandak একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra' meaning 'Moon'. This name is dedicated to Lord Chandrama, the Moon God in Hindu mythology, representing calmness, wisdom, and protection.
